ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Attack, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.AnyEnemy)` (AshenStrike.cs:27-30) == cost 1 / ATTACK / UNCOMMON / ANY_ENEMY. No keywords on either side (the Exhaust hover tip is a reference to the exhaust PILE, not an Exhaust keyword).

CanonicalTags.rationale: `new HashSet<CardTag> { CardTag.Strike }` (AshenStrike.cs:16) == the tag set that Perfected Strike counts (cards/base.py:97-98).

CanonicalVars.rationale: `CalculationBaseVar(6m)` + `ExtraDamageVar(3m)` + `CalculatedDamageVar(ValueProp.Move).WithMultiplier((card, _) => PileType.Exhaust.GetPile(card.Owner).Cards.Count)` (AshenStrike.cs:18-23). `CalculatedVar.Calculate` is `GetBaseVar().BaseValue + GetExtraVar().BaseValue * multiplier` (CalculatedVar.cs:62-71) == `self._base + self._extra * len(ctx.player.exhaust_pile)`. Prop set is Move without Unpowered -> powered damage on both sides, matching `DamageCmd.deal`'s default `DamageProps.CARD` (valueprops.py:34), so this card is NOT in gap G1's blast radius (it gains no block at all). Out-of-combat display only, folded in: CalculatedVar.Calculate yields multiplier 0 when `!(CombatManager.Instance.IsInProgress && cardModel.CombatState != null)` (CalculatedVar.cs:69); the sim's calc_damage takes a CombatCtx so it has no out-of-combat call path, and the difference is presentation.

OnPlay.rationale: `DamageCmd.Attack(DynamicVars.CalculatedDamage).FromCard(this).Targeting(cardPlay.Target)` (AshenStrike.cs:35-37) == `DamageCmd.deal(ctx.hooks, target, self.calc_damage(ctx, target), dealer=ctx.player, card=self)`. The multiplier is re-evaluated at play time on both sides (the sim calls `calc_damage` inside `on_play`, C#'s DynamicVar is a live calculation), so exhausts that happen earlier in the same turn count on both sides.

OnUpgrade.rationale: `DynamicVars.ExtraDamage.UpgradeValueBy(1m)` (AshenStrike.cs:42) == `self._extra += 1`, i.e. 6 + 4*count when upgraded. The BASE stays 6 on both sides -- the upgrade touches only the per-card multiplier term. Downgrade-safe: `_init_vars` re-seeds both `_base` and `_extra`, and `card_probes.py downgrade` does not list ashen_strike.

guards.what: the multiplier counts the OWNER's exhaust pile, and the sim reads `ctx.player.exhaust_pile` (AshenStrike.cs:22)
guards.rationale: `card.Owner` is the playing player in single-player; the sim is single-player throughout. The multi-owner reading is a multiplayer-only concern and out of scope.

guards.what: the card is an Attack whose own play does not exhaust it, so its damage does not include itself in the count
guards.rationale: On both sides Ashen Strike resolves from the Play pile (C#) / the discard-pile limbo (sim, combat.py:452-454) and only reaches the exhaust pile if something else exhausts it, so neither side counts the card itself.
